blocks.text: Maple Ridge 55+ Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: There is no verified 55-plus strata townhouse complex anywhere in Maple Ridge, and that empty result is the defining fact for this page.

The townhouse-shaped seniors housing that does exist sits in two pockets: Haney Pioneer Village at 11830 230 Street in East Central, and St. George's Village at 23580 Dewdney Trunk Road at the Cottonwood edge.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge 55+ Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Haney Pioneer Village, 11830 230 Street, is an 84-unit townhouse co-operative for active seniors aged 60-plus, with one- and two-bedroom units, private back yards and a recreation hall laundry room; it is 60-plus, never 55-plus, and members hold co-operative membership, not a strata lot.

St. George's Village Seniors Housing Co-operative, 52–23580 Dewdney Trunk Road, is the city's one 55-plus co-operative; its own membership application states the age qualification for membership is 55 years, a dependent aged 19 or older may live with a member, and the co-operative has clear title to its land.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge 55+ Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Only a 55-plus age bylaw is lawful in a British Columbia strata, under sections 123.1 and 123.2 of the Strata Property Act; any bylaw set below 55 became invalid on November 24, 2022.

Exemptions in Strata Property Regulation 7.01 cover a resident who lived in the unit when the bylaw passed, a live-in caregiver, and, from May 1, 2023, a younger spouse or partner and children in the specified resident's care.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge 55+ Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Maple Ridge Seniors Village at 22141 119 Avenue offers independent living, assisted living and complex care in one Retirement Concepts campus, which matters to a townhouse buyer planning for care later; it is rental and care housing, nothing to buy.

Chartwell Willow Retirement Community at 12275 224 Street and Sunwood at 12241 224 Street put two retirement residences on the same downtown street as the Legion buildings, forming the 224 Street seniors corridor.
Ridge Meadows Hospital at 11666 Laity Street is the Fraser Health hospital for both cities, with 24-hour emergency, maternity and surgery services.
Route 745 from Haney Place serves Cottonwood, the area of St. George's Village on Dewdney Trunk Road, and route 733 serves Rock Ridge and Port Haney from Haney Place.
Haney Place Exchange is the transfer point for the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station, which is the frequent-service link for medical and shopping trips west.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge 55+ Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Flood checking for a ground-level townhouse now uses Schedule A of Floodplain Management Bylaw No. 8121-2026, which designates flood hazard areas and floodplain setbacks for the whole city.
For a co-operative, the due diligence is the co-operative's rules, share price, housing charges and resale or buy-back terms, none of which appear on a Form B because there is no strata.

faq.a: No strata townhouse purchase with a 55-plus bylaw was found anywhere in the city. The ground-oriented seniors options are co-operatives: St. George's Village at 23580 Dewdney Trunk Road, which is 55-plus by its own membership form, and Haney Pioneer Village at 11830 230 Street, which is 60-plus. A buyer who must hold strata title should look at the Fraserview Village apartments covered on the 55-plus condos page.
faq.q: Can I buy a 55-plus townhouse in Maple Ridge?

faq.a: Calling it 55-plus would misstate the rule a 56-year-old buyer would face. It is also a co-operative, so a purchase is a membership and share transaction under the co-operative's rules, not a strata lot purchase with a Form B.
faq.q: Is Haney Pioneer Village a 55-plus complex?

faq.a: Yes, if a 55-plus strata is the purchase, because provincial exemptions cover a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement, as well as live-in caregivers and legacy residents who lived in the unit when the bylaw passed. That exemption is a Strata Property Act rule, so it helps in Fraserview Village apartments; it does not change a co-operative's own membership age rule at St. George's Village or Haney Pioneer Village.
faq.q: My partner is under 55. Could we live in a 55-plus strata here?

faq.a: The similar name is the trap: the Alouette Retirement Mobile Home Park at 12868 229 Street is the 55-plus property, and it is a manufactured-home park where a resident owns the home and rents the pad. A buyer should confirm the exact civic address and tenure before assuming any Alouette property is 55-plus.
